title: Orange and Cranberry Agar Jelly Cubes
summary: Firm, vegan jelly cubes in two colours, made by boiling orange and cranberry juice with agar powder and cutting the set slabs into cubes.
equipment: 2 square containers or tins, about 15 cm

steps.title: Oil the containers
steps.text: Wipe the inside of both containers very lightly with oil and blot off any excess with kitchen paper.

steps.title: Make the orange jelly
steps.text: Whisk the agar and sugar into the cold orange juice in one saucepan. Bring it to the boil and boil gently for 2 min, whisking, until there are no specks of agar left.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Pour the orange jelly into the first container and skim off any foam with a spoon.

steps.title: Make the cranberry jelly
steps.text: Repeat with the cranberry juice, sugar and agar in the second pan, boil for 2 min and pour into the second container.

steps.title: Let them set
steps.text: Leave both at room temperature for 30 min, then chill for 1 h, until firm enough to slice cleanly.

steps.title: Cut into cubes
steps.text: Run a knife around the edges, turn each slab out onto a board and cut into 2.5 cm cubes.

tips: The most common mistake is not boiling the agar long enough; it must boil for a full 2 min or the jelly will not set.
Agar sets as it cools, so pour straight away; if it starts to set in the pan, reheat it to a boil.
Avoid fresh pineapple or kiwi juice; they stop it setting.
Brands differ in strength; if your first batch is too soft, use a little more agar next time.
storage: Keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
